chapel_altar.promptBlock: SET: the altar of a grand old stone chapel at golden hour. Carved oak altar with ivory drapery immediately in frame, tall pointed stained-glass windows throwing amber and rose light onto the altar, white peonies and eucalyptus at the altar steps, warm dust in the sunbeams. Materials and light only — not the nave, not the entrance, not a view down the aisle.

chapel_aisle.promptBlock: SET: the center aisle of the same stone chapel at golden hour. Stone floor, white peony and eucalyptus sprays along the aisle, dark wood pews on both sides, stained-glass side light, warm dust. Materials and light only — not a shot from the church door toward a distant altar.

chapel_pew.promptBlock: SET: a front pew in the same stone chapel at golden hour. Dark wood pew, a spray of white peonies at the pew end, stained-glass side light, other pews beside. Materials and light only — the pew is the set, not a view of the altar as the subject.

car_interior.promptBlock: SET: the rear seat of a black luxury sedan at night, cream leather seats, a soft amber dome light, rain on the windows with gold and blue streetlights streaking past.

bakery_front.promptBlock: SET: the street front of a small old-fashioned corner bakery at night: dark green painted wood storefront, gold-leaf script above the window reading Ellison & Daughter, warm dim light inside, a white paper legal notice with a red stamp taped to the glass door (text not legible), wet cobblestone sidewalk reflecting an orange sodium streetlamp, three terracotta herb pots lined up beside the door.

penthouse_living.promptBlock: SET: a penthouse living room on a bright morning: floor-to-ceiling windows over a hazy city skyline, pale oak floors, a low charcoal sofa, a white marble kitchen island with a stainless espresso machine, cool soft daylight. Materials and light only — not a wide of an empty room.

penthouse_study.promptBlock: SET: a private study in the penthouse at dusk: walls of leather-bound books, a heavy walnut desk with a green banker's lamp, a tall window with glittering city lights, and on a shelf a small silver frame whose photo is too far to read. Warm lamp pools against cool blue window light.

ballroom.promptBlock: SET: an opulent hotel ballroom at a black-tie charity gala: gilded columns, crystal chandeliers, a white marble staircase, warm gold light. Materials and light only — not a wide of the whole room. Guests if any stay at the frame edges, out of focus.

terrace.promptBlock: SET: a moonlit stone terrace off the ballroom: wrought-iron railing, strings of warm lights, potted olive trees, the city skyline glittering below, cool blue night light with warm gold spilling from tall glass doors behind.

cellar.promptBlock: SET: the brick-vaulted cellar kitchen beneath the Ellison & Daughter bakery at night: a massive antique brick bread oven with a blackened iron door, wooden proofing racks, flour-dusted steel worktables, copper pans on hooks, a single caged bare bulb giving weak amber light, drifting dust, a narrow street-level window high on the back wall, a steep wooden stairway rising into darkness at the rear.

Tight two-shot: MARA stepping back from DAMIAN, eyes wide with hurt and suspicion, the silver ring visible on her trembling hand; DAMIAN reaching for her, stricken; red-blue light strobing across both faces.
scenes.videoPrompt: Mara backs away from Damian, the ledger clutched to her chest, the silver ring trembling on her hand. Broken: 'Did you know?' Damian, stricken, reaching for her: 'Mara, I swear...' She shakes her head. The sirens peak; cut to black.
